# The Tax Firm

> Advanced tax strategy and planning for small business owners and high-income earners.

## About

The Tax Firm is a tax strategy and planning practice based in Las Vegas, Nevada, led by Christopher Craig, an IRS Enrolled Agent with over 10 years of experience. Unlike traditional CPAs who focus on tax compliance and filing, The Tax Firm specializes in proactive, year-round tax planning that helps clients legally reduce their tax burden by 20-40% or more.

## Services

- Tax Mitigation & Strategy: Proactive year-round tax planning, entity structuring (S-Corp elections, LLCs, holding companies), advanced deductions, and income shifting strategies.
- Fractional CFO: Strategic financial planning, reporting, budgeting, cash flow management, and investor readiness for businesses earning $250K+.
- Bookkeeping: Full-service bookkeeping, payroll processing, AP/AR management, monthly financial statements, and tax-ready records.
- Asset Protection: Legal strategies to shield business and personal assets from lawsuits, creditors, and unnecessary exposure.
- Wealth Building: Tax-efficient wealth accumulation, retirement planning, and generational wealth strategies.
- Roth Conversion Strategies: Tax-optimized Roth conversion ladders, including the Arcade Game Strategy using bonus depreciation under IRC Section 168(k).
- Real Estate Tax Strategy: Cost segregation studies, 1031 exchanges, the Augusta Rule, and entity structuring for real estate investors.

## Ideal Clients

- Small business owners earning $200,000+ annually
- High-income W-2 employees frustrated with their tax burden
- Real estate investors managing multiple properties or entities
- Entrepreneurs and executives seeking advanced tax strategies beyond standard CPA services
